checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["mug","beaker","multi","asset"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()

transitions.description: Coffee mug (mixing beaker) model is loaded and visible in the scene

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["lantern","multi","asset","chemistry-lab"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()

transitions.description: Lantern (Bunsen burner heat source) model is loaded and visible in the scene

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; for (const k of Object.keys(s)) { const v = s[k]; if (Array.isArray(v) && v.length >= 3) return true; if (typeof v === 'number' && v >= 3) return true; } return false; })()

transitions.description: At least three draggable reagent capsules exist in the scene and are positioned distinctly from the mug

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; for (const k of Object.keys(s)) { const v = s[k]; if (Array.isArray(v) && v.length >= 1) return true; if (typeof v === 'number' && v >= 1) return true; } return false; })()
